name: motion-surprise-take
title: Take
description: Nhân vật co lại một nhịp, vươn dài mở to mắt như giật mình, rồi về dáng và giữ nguyên.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Recipe: compress 120 ms, stretch 200 ms, settle 280 ms back.out, hold. Demo: at 0.6 s scaleY 1 -> 0.8 in 100 ms (scaleX = 2 - scaleY), then a spring (stiffness 260, damping 9) back to 1 with an overshooting stretch; eyes open to 1.4 x, mouth appears; 5 surprise lines above fade 1.0-1.4 s. Params: squash (0.8) · spring (260 / 9) · lines (5). Compress, then a spring (k260 c9) overshoots into a stretch; the eyes open 1.4× and five lines flash above.
